ALDER PEAK ROBOTICS, INC.
STOCK OPTION GRANT NOTICE
Grant No. APR-2027-0113

Optionee: Jordan Vale
Date of Grant: February 3, 2027
Vesting Commencement Date: January 12, 2027
Type of Option: Non-Qualified Stock Option
The Company hereby grants you an option to purchase 40,000 shares of Common Stock at an exercise price of $1.85 per share.
The grant was approved by the Board of Directors on February 3, 2027.
The option vests over 48 months, with a 12 month cliff on the first anniversary of the Vesting Commencement Date, and 1/48th of the shares vesting monthly thereafter.
The option expires ten years from the date of grant.
Following your termination of service, you may exercise vested shares within 90 days after your last day of service.
Early exercise is not permitted under this grant.
The shares are subject to a right of first refusal and the transfer restrictions set out in the 2024 Equity Incentive Plan.
The Company may repurchase vested shares acquired on exercise upon termination for cause at the lower of cost and fair market value.
No vesting acceleration applies to this grant.
This notice is governed by the 2024 Equity Incentive Plan and your Stock Option Agreement.
